title: Immense

inlines.v: IMMENSE, adjective immens'. [Latin immensus; in and mensus, metior, to measure.] 1. Unlimited; unbounded; infinite. O goodness infinite! goodness immense! 2. Vast in extent; very great; as an immense distance. 3. Huge in bulk; very large; as the immense body of Jupiter.
